== styled == 
type CardProps<T> = { item: T; title: string; active?: boolean };

export const Card = <T extends { id: string }>({ item, ...props }: CardProps<T>) => (
  <>
    <article {...props} data-id={item.id}>
      <h2>{props.title}</h2>
      {props.active && <span>{`active ${item.id}`}</span>}
    </article>
  </>
);
